name: Aflac Japan
verdict: Aflac Life Insurance Japan Ltd., a subsidiary of NYSE-listed Aflac Incorporated. Nothing found.
aliases: アフラック生命保険株式会社
note: Kit sponsor (back, above the number) of Kashiwa Reysol 2026-27 per https://www.reysol.co.jp/news/goods/202627-4.html . Rating note: Aflac Incorporated's 5% holders are Vanguard (11.1%), BlackRock (8.2%) and the J&A Alliance Trust (10.2% of the shares, votes limited to 20%), whose sole beneficiary is Japan Post Holdings; the 2026 proxy says Japan Post Holdings has no board seat and no control rights. Japan's Minister of Finance holds 36.43% of Japan Post Holdings (as of 30 June 2026, https://www.japanpost.jp/en/ir/stock/index10.html), so the Japanese state's indirect stake is about 3.7%; Japan has no record in this data, so it is not a link either way. Quick company check (2026-09-30): no court, regulator, UN or major-NGO human-rights finding against Aflac found.
